description:
Founding Product Manager at Meridian Labs

Meridian is a seed-stage company (9 people, $4M raised) building a product for independent financial advisors. We've got early traction and are ready for our first PM.

This is a founding role, not a product-ops role. That means
- You own discovery, prioritization, and shipping. The two co-founders will argue with you, not overrule you.
- You sit in customer calls. 3-6 per week during the first two quarters.
- You run weekly product reviews. You write the spec. You cut the features we don't need.
- You do analytics yourself. SQL is table stakes.

What we need
- 4+ years as a PM, at least two years at a startup <30 people.
- Discovery chops. You have a system for customer research and you can show us.
- SQL. Python is a plus. Do not tell us 'I'm not technical' — you are if you want to be.
- Strong writing. We'll ask for PRD samples in round 2.
- You can tell us about a product call you made that you're still proud of two years later.

Reasonable nice-to-haves
- FinTech exposure (not required, not a filter).
- Design sensibility — at this stage you'll co-design surfaces with the design lead.
